text:
maya: quick async standup — ran a focused sweep on GPU lanes during the odd hour
maya: what I did: scanned us-west + eu-west usage, flagged two nodes in us-west at ~95% allocation
maya: blockers: a couple of ETL jobs are pinning GPUs with local PVs so we can’t evict them cleanly right now
maya: today: plan to draft a drain plan, patch the autoscaler thresholds, and open a PR (link below)
liam: saw the note, thanks — what’s ETA on the PR review?
serena: pinging infra-bot for a quick quota snapshot so we know headroom across regions
infra-bot: quota snapshot: us-west: 120 GPUs total, 112 allocated, 8 spare; eu-west: 90 total, 66 allocated, 24 spare; apac: 48 total, 48 allocated, 0 spare
josh: suggestion — temporary safe policy: shorten scale-down cooldown and bump preemptible pool in us-west. Can you paste the autoscaler config you plan to change?
maya: autoscaler snippet I’ll propose:
```yaml
minReplicas: 10
maxReplicas: 120
targetGPUUtilization: 0.78
scaleDownCooldown: 600s
```
liam: small nit — recommend targetGPUUtilization = 0.75 for a bit more headroom during spikes
maya: noted, will update the PR to 0.75
serena: blocker: apac quota request (REQ-3897) still pending with cloud-quotas team, that will limit canaries to eu-west for now
josh: for canaries, route apac traffic to eu-west fallback if quota is not approved; update routing policy in redis to include fallback mapping
maya: quick test logs I ran locally:
```bash
# quick node check
kubectl get nodes -l cloud=us-west,gpu=true -o wide
# sample output:
# gpu-az1-42   Ready   95% alloc   8 pods
```
liam: I can review the PR in ~30m and merge if green
maya: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/842 — includes autoscaler patch + drain plan draft
serena: opened INFRA-2145 to enumerate jobs using local PVs so we can coordinate owners for eviction notices
josh: small ask — please ensure training jobs annotated with training/dont-evict=true are excluded from the automatic drain
maya: will exclude annotated jobs, adding the exclusion list to INFRA-2145
infra-bot: deployed autoscaler patch to staging at 6312345900 for verification
liam: after merge can we do a staged rollout? 10% -> 50% -> 100% seems safe
maya: yep, will add staged rollout steps to the PR description and trigger a canary in eu-west first
serena: ACK, I’ll chase REQ-3897 for apac quota and update this thread
josh: no blockers from me, happy to help validate canary metrics once deployed :thumbsup:
maya: thanks all — I’ll post another quick update when PR lands or in 10m if anything changes
